ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels comprise approximately 70% of the visible fluke surface, with high-contrast low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the peduncle junction and along the trailing edge margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity pigmentation forms a V-shaped anchor at the medial base; high-contrast black 'feathering' patterns extend along the trailing edge boundaries; localized low-intensity focal spots are distributed across the lower medial regions of the white lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated acute V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 45 degrees and moderate bounding-box depth relative to the lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with variable pixel-amplitude; notable high-amplitude jagged protrusions located on the distal third of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to distinctive upward-sweeping distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregular jagged contouring and deep notches on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe (image right), indicative of significant tissue loss or traumatic amputation.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced 'brush-stroke' gradient pattern at the transition boundary between the black central pigmentation and the white fluke lobes.
